controls.oracle: The exact deliverable,amount,evidence header admits quoted commas, doubled quotes, LF inside evidence, LF/CRLF record separators and one optional leading UTF-8 BOM. Preserve row order and every title/amount/evidence code unit, including leading/trailing spaces, leading zeroes, Unicode, literal HTML-looking text and empty unfinished fields. Record-separator CRLF must not normalize field-internal CR; quoted CR or CRLF inside any field must be refused by the native editor-preservation contract.

Receive 1 and12 rows, reject0 and13 including an all-empty13th row. Receive exact native limits for label120/brief8000/cap64/title160/amount64/evidence5000 and rejectone-over values. Preserve unfinished amount spellings such as empty,0,1e3,plus sign,too many decimals and unsafe cent magnitudes as draft strings where codec permits; show review readiness consistent with validateScopeDraft/draftBudget. Do not silently coerce, trim or round. Whitespace/leading-zero valid dollar strings stay literal in draft but produce native review values after explicit review.

Reject duplicate/missing/extra/case-or-space-altered headers and unsupported header order; reject ragged/interior empty physical records, stray/unclosed quotes, text after a closing quote, lone CR separators and input beyond the declared UTF-8 byte bound. A final record terminator must not add a checkpoint, while an explicit ',,' row counts. Browser file decoding must reject malformed UTF-8; a literal correctly encoded U+FFFD remains valid text. Exactly one leading BOM is optional, and a second leading BOM must not disappear through two decoder/parser normalization steps.

Every successful explicit download must equal native encodeScopeWorkspace for the exact parsed draft and decode through the unchanged codec. Require fixtureOnly:true,paymentEvidence:false,stage:'draft',events:[],evidenceDrafts:[],review:null,summary approved/events0. Approval/event-looking cell text stays plain text; it cannot select a schema/stage or create ledger events. Conversion/review/download must not write browser storage, call providers or alter another open authoring workspace/pending import.

In real Chromium defer one actual File.arrayBuffer/text read. Metadata edits, a newly chosen file or Cancel retire old preview and download eligibility. A newer reviewed file cannot be replaced by the late older completion. No native download occurs before explicit review and explicit download; forced stale-control activation after invalidation may not export the prior review. Re-review uses the latest literal file and label/brief/cap values. Record any transport adaptation separately from these assertions.
